short_description: Actinic keratosis is a rough, scaly skin lesion caused by long-term sun exposure. It is considered a precancerous condition and should be monitored by a dermatologist.
temporary_advice: Protect the skin from direct sunlight
Avoid scratching or picking the lesion
Monitor changes in size, color, or texture
avoid: Do not ignore a persistent rough patch
Do not pick or cut the lesion
risk_notes: Actinic keratosis can sometimes develop into skin cancer if left untreated, so medical evaluation is important.
when_to_see_doctor: If the lesion grows, bleeds, or becomes painful
If several rough sun spots appear
If you are unsure about the diagnosis
